comparisons.question: Did Salander and Mikael have affair?
comparisons.answer: Yes, Lisbeth Salander and Mikael Blomkvist had an affair. The books state that they slept together for half a year, which was initiated by Salander [E1]. Although the relationship ended abruptly when Salander cut off all contact with him, Blomkvist reflects on their time together as a romantic involvement, referring to himself as her "ex-boyfriend" and acknowledging that he missed her [E1]. During the events of the first book, they also share intimate moments, such as showering together and Salander sleeping in his bed, though she later ends the relationship [E2], [E3].
